text.ms:
1. This order may be cited as the Ports (Privatisation) (Tanjung Pelepas
Port) Order 1999.

2147                  P.U. (A) 328-329.

— — a — — Aan

Amendment of Schedule

2. The Schedule to the Ports (Privatisation) Act 1990 is amended by inserting

the words "Tanjung Pelepas Port", "Johor Port Authority (Tanjung Pelepas)"
and "Port Authorities Act 1963" in columns (1), (2) and (3) respectively,

Made 2 August 1999.
[KP/BM/JL/0.73/49; PN(PU?)483]

Dato' Seri Dr. Linc Liong Sik
Minister of Transport

P.U. (A) 329.
AKTA OPTIK 1991

PERATURAN-PERATURAN OPTIK (PINDAAN) 1999

Papa menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 42 Akta Optik 1991 (Akta
469], Menteri, selepas berunding dengan Majlis, membuat peraturan-peraturan
yang berikut:

Nama

1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Optik
(Pindaan) 1999.

Pindaan Borang 11

2. Borang 11 Peraturan-Peraturan Optik 1994 (P.U, (A) 210/94) dipinda dengan
menggantikan perkataan "Menteri" dengan perkataan "Majlis".

OPTICAL ACT 1991

OpTICAL (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 1999

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 42 of the Optical Act 1991 [Act
469), the Minister, after consulting the Council, makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Optical (Amendment) Regulations

Amendment of Form 11

2. Form 1! of the Optical Regulations 1994 (P.U. (A) 210/94] is amended by
substituting for the word "Minister" the word "Council".

Dibuat 26 Julai 1999,

Made 26 July 1999.
(KKM. 87 (A60/1); PN(PU?)503/1I]

Dato' Chua Jui Meng
Menteri Kesihatan/
Minister of Health
